visualizations.title: 双缝时空体
visualizations.summary: 把双缝与延迟选择擦除的一次运行画成静态时空体。路径记录可以用 2 到 8 个读数的仪器读取，每个读数一个条件时空，它们相加总是同一个总体；还可以切换钟条件化、展开第四轴、交换读取顺序，并对时间做非线性重标。
visualizations.summary_en: One run of the double-slit and delayed-choice eraser drawn as a static spacetime block. The path record can be read by an instrument with 2 to 8 outcomes; each outcome defines a conditional spacetime, and together they always add up to the same whole. You can also switch clock conditioning, unfold a fourth axis, swap the read order and relabel time nonlinearly.
